name: i-Control Holdings Limited
summary: i-Control Holdings Limited, established in 1987 and headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company providing video conferencing and multimedia audiovisual solutions to clients in Hong Kong, mainland China and Singapore. Its two divisions deploy and maintain these solutions and offer managed, cloud-based IT and operational technology services, including AIoT operations and security. Customers include government bodies, financial firms, multinationals, listed companies and schools.
